text:
GENERATE BURST KV-S2 — Run C-9 P7, S visor, second method (Matt: the S attempts failed). task_id "KV-S2".

Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 (the knight facing STRAIGHT TOWARD THE VIEWER, south). IMAGE 2 is the SAME knight turned 45 degrees to the viewer's lower-right; IMAGE 3 is the SAME knight turned 45 degrees to the viewer's lower-left. Both helms in IMAGES 2 and 3 are APPROVED. Replace ONLY the helm in IMAGE 1 with that SAME helm seen from exactly halfway between IMAGES 2 and 3 — straight from the front. It must look like the same object: take its skull shape, its visor shape and how far the visor projects, its sight slit, its breathing holes, its steel colour and its painted marks from IMAGES 2 and 3, and show them from the front, symmetric left to right. Do NOT invent a different helm design.
Paint it in EXACTLY the same hand. Keep EVERYTHING ELSE in IMAGE 1 exactly as it is: body, pose, gorget, tabard and heraldry, pollaxe in his right hand, size, position, flat pure #00ff00 background. For this step the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY THE IMAGES: do not restyle.

Two image_gen EDIT calls: variants a and b. ONE retry per variant only if the helm is not recognisably the helm of IMAGES 2 and 3 seen from the front, anything besides the helm changed, or the background is not flat green — name the reason. Copy outputs to out/KV-S2_a.png and out/KV-S2_b.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "KV-S2"; images = the files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — THE IMAGE TO EDIT (replace only the helm; facing the viewer)
